a.lede: Faster GPUs are no longer enough as power constraints, network congestion, and communication overhead force the industry to rethink how massive AI systems are built.
a.title: Power and cooling limits force AI clusters with 100,000+ accelerators to use multiple data centers

b.lede: IEA's report says that power production and distribution is barely keeping up with the rapid growth of AI data centers.
b.title: AI data center power demand will double by 2030 thanks to $4 trillion in spending, adding an entire Great Britain to energy strain
